stem: A student makes a mixture of gravel, iron filings, and water. Which table correctly identifies the tools that can be used to separate each substance from the mixture?

options.label: A
options.text:
Tool     Substance Separated from Mixture
Screen   Gravel
Magnet   Iron filings
Paper filter   Water

options.label: B
options.text:
Tool     Substance Separated from Mixture
Funnel   Gravel
Paper filter   Iron filings
Hot plate   Water

options.label: C
options.text:
Tool     Substance Separated from Mixture
Screen   Gravel
Hot Plate   Iron filings
Funnel   Water

options.label: D
options.text:

visual_elements: Four tables labeled A, B, C, and D, each showing three tools paired with the substances gravel, iron filings, or water.
